narrative.details:
You've proven yourself by taming a boar and a wolf, now it's time for your final challenge. Elwynn's balance depends on respect and skill. Take this Taming Rod and seek out a Young Forest Bear. Show that you can earn the trust of even the mightiest companion.

Completing this lesson will deepen your attunement to beasts.
narrative.objectives: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Young Forest Bear. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Josephine Carson.
narrative.offerRewardText: The brawn of the forest. Brave work, Darlin!
narrative.requestItemsText: Go forth, Darlin, and tame the burliest of Elwynn beasts.

mentionedItems.name: Taming Rod
tooltip: Use: Begins taming a Young Forest Bear to be your companion for 10 minutes. If you lose the beast's attention for any reason, the taming process will fail.
